note: Appanoose County Conservation Board park on the southwest side of Centerville, between the city's upper and lower reservoirs; the campground loop is in woods at the upper reservoir's north-east corner, across the park road from the shore. Boat ramps and docks on both reservoirs, a kayak launch on the upper one, three miles of trails. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 15 FHU 50A sites, shower house, FCFS. Still no rate (none posted). Waterfront downgrade lead lakefront -> lakeview (park road and a tree row between the loop and the water). Pin ~290 m off: corrected.
flags: WATERFRONT downgrade lead: lakefront -> lakeview. The stored note itself said 'Camping area set back from the water'. On NAIP the campground is one wooded loop (centre ~40.71515,-92.88674, matching Google's pin) whose south pads are ~27-37 m from the upper reservoir, with the park road, a mown strip and a row of shoreline trees between; nothing is on-water (0 candidates). A filtered view through the tree row from the south pads is plausible, and a camper (Campendium, 2020-12-06) wrote 'Some have complete tree coverage and others are open and closer to the water'; no official photos exist, so lakeview rests on imagery and that review.

BELOW-DAM: does not apply. The loop sits beside the upper (western) reservoir at about its pool level (Open-Meteo DEM ~303 m at the loop, ~298-302 m on the upper pool, ~283-296 m on the lower, eastern reservoir); the lower reservoir is ~250 m+ east, past the upper dam's road and a wooded ridge.

FEES: still no rate. Neither county page posts one; the county sends callers to (641) 856-8528 (an October 2026 event listing says to call ACCB 'to learn about the special camping rates'). Camper reports say $15 (Campendium 'Last Price Paid', from 2020; ParkAdvisor 2018-2022), too old to use and not allowed while the operator has a page.
PIN (~290 m off): stored 40.7133,-92.8843 is a boat-ramp road end on the peninsula south-east of the campground. Proposed location 40.71515,-92.88674 (the loop on NAIP; pads partly under canopy).
SEASON: unread. The stored 'closed winter' rests on the old note; no county page states a season (a 2020 camper found it 'still open' in November). Left alone.
FACILITIES: a camper reported 'No dump station' (Campendium, 2020-12-06) and '30 amp available'; the county page says 50 amp. Dump left unset.

WEBSITE: the county's own page is https://appanoosecounty.iowa.gov/departments/conservation/ (Google's listing links it); the mycountyparks page holds the campground facts. Keep both. Phone 641-856-8528 matches.
